sections.title: Working with people
sections.description: Think about school, work, friendships, teams, or helping others.

sections.title: Knowing yourself
sections.description: Think about how you respond to challenges, feedback, and responsibilities.

sections.title: Tools & problem-solving
sections.description: Consider what you have practiced or would enjoy practicing. Experience is not required.

sections.title: Your working personality
sections.description: Choose what feels like you today. There are no better or worse personalities.

sections.title: How you like to learn
sections.description: These are preferences, not fixed learning types. Different tasks may call for different approaches.

sections.title: Where life happens
sections.description: Describe the settings you prefer. These answers do not exclude any career category.

questions.text: I listen carefully when someone has a concern and check that I understand.
I can explain an idea in a way that helps someone else understand it.
I enjoy bringing people together to work toward a shared goal.
When people disagree, I try to understand both sides before responding.
I feel comfortable offering practical help to someone who is struggling.
I can notice when I am stressed and take steps to manage it.
I usually follow through on responsibilities, even when the task is repetitive.
I can use constructive feedback to change how I approach a task.
I enjoy setting a goal and organizing the steps needed to reach it.
I am willing to keep investigating a problem when the answer is not obvious.
I enjoy working with numbers, spreadsheets, or data to understand a problem.
I enjoy learning how tools, machines, or physical systems work.
I am interested in understanding the human body and how to support health.
I enjoy comparing documents or sources and checking whether a claim is supported.
I enjoy creating instructions, demonstrations, or materials that help people learn.
I enjoy persuading others to support an idea, project, or initiative.
I prefer tasks with clear procedures and a well-defined chain of responsibility.
I enjoy trying new approaches when an existing way of doing something is not working.
I am drawn to work that improves how communities or public institutions function.
I enjoy practical tasks where I can see a concrete result of my work.
Reading a clear explanation or seeing a diagram helps me get started.
Watching someone demonstrate a task helps me understand it.
Trying a task myself and learning from mistakes helps me make progress.
Discussing a topic or explaining it to someone else helps me learn.
A structured course with milestones and feedback helps me stay on track.
Staying close to my current community is important to me.
I would consider relocating for an opportunity that fits my goals.
I would prefer to do at least some of my work remotely.
I prefer smaller communities or rural settings over large cities.
I would enjoy a role that includes regular travel or changing work locations.

careers.description: Support health and wellbeing through care, science, technology, or administration.
careers.next_step: Talk to someone in a healthcare role about their everyday tasks and training.

careers.description: Help organizations operate, solve problems, serve customers, and develop ideas.
careers.next_step: Plan a small project: define the customer, cost, timeline, and intended benefit.

careers.description: Help people learn and grow in classrooms, workplaces, or communities.
careers.next_step: Explain a topic you enjoy to someone else and ask what helped them understand.

careers.description: Explore service roles involving teamwork, technical work, logistics, and structured responsibility.
careers.next_step: Research different service roles, commitments, and eligibility requirements using official sources.

careers.description: Explore legal research, advocacy, procedures, and support for people navigating legal systems.
careers.next_step: Compare two accounts of a public legal issue and separate claims from supporting evidence.

careers.description: Build, install, repair, and maintain the physical systems people rely on.
careers.next_step: Explore a local apprenticeship or observe a qualified tradesperson working safely.

careers.description: Explore public policy, civic service, government administration, and community representation.
careers.next_step: Attend or watch a local public meeting and identify one issue you would like to understand.
